description.short: Forecast judgment for stalled deals — recoverable vs flat no.
description.full: Lazarus Deal Recovery helps sales managers run cleaner forecast calls: which deals will close, which are recoverable versus a flat no, and what to do next. Keep Microsoft Teams; Lazarus is the judgment layer on top. This app opens the Lazarus companion as a personal tab and, when you add it in a meeting, as a side panel. It does not join as a hidden bot, does not send chat messages, and does not pull Graph live transcripts — use mic or paste in the companion, or connect Outlook thread search from the Lazarus website. Human-led, AI-assisted. Not an AI SDR.
